I implemented `format_value`, `format_result`, `run_repl` and `main` in `minidb/cli.py`. All 13 tests in `tests/test_cli.py` pass. I didn't edit the test file.

If a `.exit` line arrives while a statement is half-typed (no closing `;`), that partial statement is dropped. The leftover-buffer run only happens at plain end of input.
